metadata.title: अबूझमाड़ : आदिवासी को ना राशन ना अध्यापक | Abhujmad: Tribals travel 35 Kilometers to get ration
metadata.description: Abujmad, nestled within the Bastar division of Chhattisgarh, is veiled by dense forests, making access a formidable challenge. To traverse its terrain, one must navigate rivers and streams, marking a journey fraught with obstacles. Despite recent efforts to connect certain villages with roads, the essentials of modern living remain elusive in the tribal hamlets of Abujmad. In this ground report, the stark reality unfolds, shedding light on the persistent gap in basic facilities plaguing these remote communities.
